name: Engineering Founders [Building Again - 14th May 26]
structure: CHECK(connected: MSG x1 | new: VIEW > INVITE(note x1)(accepted: MSG x1 | not: LIKE > INMAIL))

variants.body: Hi {FIRST_NAME} - I'm hosting an event for 100+ second-time founders at Google's London HQ on 14th May with Gus Martins from DeepMind. Discussing the question on every founder's mind: how do you build a moat when the underlying models keep evolving faster than you? {LINK}

steps.fallback: Hi- I'm hosting an event for 100+ second-time founders at Google's London HQ on 14th May with Gus Martins from DeepMind. Discussing the question on every founder's mind: how do you build a moat when the underlying models keep evolving faster than you? {LINK}

Hi, good to connect. 

Dropping a quick note as the event is on track to oversubscribe, and we will be closing registrations shortly. 

For context, our last event featured the founders of MuleSoft ($6bn exit to Salesforce), Paddle ($2bn exit), and attendees included the founders of Wayve, Carwow, Funding Circle, ComplyAdvantage, and Bloom & Wild.

Would be great to see you there, if you can make it. {LINK}
